title: Sanctions compliance policy
text: Acme Corp sanctions compliance policy, version 3. All vendors must be screened against sanctions lists before onboarding. Vendors connected to a sanctioned entity through ownership, directors or shared addresses must be escalated to compliance. Screening of all vendors is repeated annually.

title: Vendor risk policy
text: Vendor risk ratings are reviewed by the procurement team each quarter. High risk vendors require a second approval from the chief financial officer.
